description: This Java class defines a REST controller for managing in-app notifications in a backend API. It provides endpoints for creating notifications, listing notifications for a user, toggling their read status, and deleting notifications, with role-based access control annotations.

classes.name: NotificationsController
classes.description: REST controller providing endpoints to manage notifications within the application, with role-based access restrictions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new notification based on the provided request data, accessible only by admins.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notifications for a specific user.

methods.name: markRead
methods.description: Marks a notification as read or unread based on the user request.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a notification identified by its ID, restricted to admin users.
